mapper.select: SELECT URL FROM UI_URL_NOLOG WHERE USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT A.USER_ID AS USERID, A.USER_NM AS NAME, A.COCD, B.CONM, A.GENERALCD AS SUBORGCD, C.GENERALNM AS SUBORGNM, A.BUSICD, D.BUSINM, A.DEPTCD, E.DEPTNM, A.JIKGUBCD, G.JIKGUBNM, A.CEO FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT H.USER_ID, H.USER_NM, H.COCD, H.GENERALCD, H.BUSICD, H.DEPTCD, H.JIKINCD, H.JIKGUBCD, CASE WHEN IFNULL(I.USER_ID,'N') != 'N' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CEO FROM UI_USERS H LEFT JOIN UI_CEO I ON H.USER_ID = I.USER_ID ) AS RS ) A LEFT OUTER JOIN UI_CO B ON A.COCD = B.COCD LEFT OUTER JOIN UI_GENERAL C ON A.GENERALCD = C.GENERALCD LEFT OUTER JOIN UI_BUSI D ON A.BUSICD = D.BUSICD LEFT OUTER JOIN UI_DEPT E ON A.DEPTCD = E.DEPTCD LEFT OUTER JOIN UI_JIKIN F ON A.JIKINCD = F.JIKINCD LEFT OUTER JOIN UI_JIKGUB G ON A.JIKGUBCD = G.JIKGUBCD LIMIT ${offset}, ${pageSize}
SELECT USER_ID AS USERID, USER_IP AS IP FROM UI_USER_IP ORDER BY USER_ID LIMIT ${offset}, ${pageSize}

SELECT USER_ID AS USERID,
CAST(if(USER_EMAIL is null, null, xcndec(#{encryptAlgorithm}, #{encryptSize}, #{encryptKey}, USER_EMAIL)) AS CHAR) AS EMAILADDR
USER_EMAIL AS EMAILADDR
FROM UI_USER_EMAIL ORDER BY USER_ID LIMIT ${offset}, ${pageSize}
SELECT USER_ID AS USERID, SERVICECD AS SERVICECD,ACCOUNT AS ACCOUNT FROM UI_USER_ACCOUNT ORDER BY USER_ID LIMIT ${offset}, ${pageSize}
SELECT CODE, NAME, REGEX FROM UI_REGEXP
SELECT CAST(DEVICE_SEQ AS CHAR) AS EID, DEVICE_NM AS NAME, DEVICE_IP AS IP FROM UI_DEVICE WHERE USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT B.COCD, C.BUSICD, DATE_FORMAT(A.`DATE`, '%Y-%m-%d' ) AS `DATE`, A.COMMENT COMMENTS FROM UI_HOLIDAY A, UI_CO B, UI_BUSI C WHERE A.BUSICD = C.BUSICD AND B.COCD = C.COCD UNION SELECT '00000', BUSICD, DATE_FORMAT(`DATE`, '%Y-%m-%d' ) AS `DATE`, COMMENT FROM UI_HOLIDAY WHERE BUSICD = '00000'
SELECT B.COCD, C.BUSICD, A.WDAY, A.WHOUR FROM UI_WORKDAY A, UI_CO B, UI_BUSI C WHERE A.BUSICD = C.BUSICD AND B.COCD = C.COCD
SELECT A.START_IP AS SIP, A.END_IP AS EIP, A.BUSICD, B.BUSINM, C.COCD, C.CONM, 'I' AS INSIDE FROM UI_BUSI_IPRANGE A, UI_BUSI B, UI_CO C WHERE A.BUSICD = B.BUSICD AND B.COCD = C.COCD
SELECT A.START_IP AS SIP, A.END_IP AS EIP, A.DEPTCD, B.DEPTNM, C.COCD, C.CONM, 'I' AS INSIDE FROM UI_DEPT_IPRANGE A, UI_DEPT B, UI_CO C WHERE A.DEPTCD = B.DEPTCD AND B.COCD = C.COCD

SELECT KEYWORD_NAME AS KEYWORD FROM UI_KEYWORD JOIN UI_KEYWORD_GROUP ON UI_KEYWORD.GROUP_SEQ = UI_KEYWORD_GROUP.GROUP_SEQ WHERE UI_KEYWORD_GROUP.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY KEYWORD_NAME LIMIT ${offset}, ${pageSize}
SELECT B.SERVICECD, A.SUBJECT FROM UI_SUBJECT_NOLOG A, UI_SERVICE B WHERE A.SERVICECD = LEFT(B.SERVICECD, 3) AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT B.SERVICECD, A.LOWSIZE, A.HIGHSIZE, A.SIZE_CONDITION FROM UI_SIZE_LOG A, UI_SERVICE B WHERE A.SERVICECD = LEFT(B.SERVICECD, 3) AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT B.SERVICECD, A.USER_ID AS USERID FROM UI_ID_NOLOG A, UI_SERVICE B WHERE A.SERVICECD = LEFT(B.SERVICECD, 3) AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT B.SERVICECD, A.DOMAIN FROM UI_DOMAIN_NOLOG A, UI_SERVICE B WHERE A.SERVICECD = LEFT(B.SERVICECD, 3) AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
